title: Give the engine the least Exchange right: write the tag attributes and read recipients
purpose: Replaces the engine's organization-wide Entra role Exchange Recipient Administrator with one Exchange role group holding one custom management role: read recipients, and write only CustomAttribute1 to CustomAttribute15 on mailboxes and mail users. Step 2 removes the Entra role once the engine's tag writes went through.
whenToRun: Once, as an Exchange administrator, after user tagging is on. Step 2 (-RemoveRecipientAdministrator) after the engine's next user tagging run.

runAs.name: Exchange Administrator
runAs.why: creates the custom management role, the role group and the Exchange service principal (Organization Management)

runAs.name: Privileged Role Administrator (step 2 only)
runAs.why: removes the engine's Entra role assignment

changes.object: the management role 'EPS Tag Writer' (from 'Mail Recipients', pared to Get-Recipient, Set-Mailbox and Set-MailUser; the two Set cmdlets limited to -Identity and -CustomAttribute1..15)
changes.why: the engine writes the tag attributes and reads recipients - nothing else

changes.object: the role group 'EPS Tag Writers' with that role, the engine identity as its member (and the engine's Exchange service principal, if missing)
changes.why: an app-only Exchange admin right for exactly that role

changes.object: the engine identity's Entra role Exchange Recipient Administrator (step 2, -RemoveRecipientAdministrator)
changes.why: the role group replaces it - least privilege

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.help: the subscription Entra Policy Suite is installed in

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.help: the install's resource group (found by itself when it is not given)

parameters.name: RemoveRecipientAdministrator
parameters.help: step 2: remove the engine's Entra role Exchange Recipient Administrator - only after the engine's tag writes went through the role group

readsOnly: Exchange: the organization config, the service principals, the management role and its entries, the role group
Entra: the engine identity's role assignments
whatIf: Every step it would take; nothing is changed.
undo: Run Enable-EpsExchangeAccess.ps1 to give the engine the Entra role again; remove the role group and the role in Exchange.
